reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs support it: p0037/p0042 are product/project exclusivity covenants, p0061 uses 'employee' only as a relationship descriptor, and none of the three imposes any solicitation, hiring, or inducement restriction on the Customer.

The rule is a presence check whose preferred position is 'No non-solicit on Customer'; absence of any such covenant satisfies the preferred position, so no redline or counterparty comment is expected or warranted.
Rendered paragraphs are byte-identical to the originals, correctly avoiding the introduction of a restrictive covenant (and its carve-out) that the counterparty never sought.

The two failed deterministic checks (12-month duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause to measure; they do not evidence a defect and cannot be cured without drafting an adverse covenant.
Party mapping is correct (The Deerskin Companies, Inc. as Customer; HDI as vendor/host), and the exclusivity observation is flagged as out-of-scope rather than smuggled into this finding.
